column2: observed data only: stock Octoshock 2.3 core and passive observer core via the shock_* DLL API; authored CPU/MMIO programs; no BIOS, no retail data

D rows: from the observer core dispatch trace (cycle, kind, budget after dispatch, phase, queued, words). budget_delta and cycles_since_prev are successive observer-trace budgets/cycles; charge_from_full = 256 - budget_after when the previous trace row is >= 60000 cycles earlier (after the authored settle wait), else NA

NA in the PS1B-182 route schema: projection_charge/sink_charge split, budget_pre_process, clip/offset/draw_mode/texture_window/mask_bits/display_mode/field_valid/skip_field columns, and all C (credit) rows: the observer API does not expose them

S, R, W timings are guest-observed: timer 2 on sysclk (CPU cycles), unwrapped 16-bit, relative to t_start sampled just before the first test word; granularity is the poll loop period, measured by case calib-poll-no-gpu (see K row)
S runs break on any change of GPUSTAT bits 0-12,14-30 (bits 13 and 31 are raster-driven and ignored for run breaks; first/last full values are given)
